Explain briefly why a metal spoon left in hot soup becomes warm at the handle. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Metal conducts heat well. Hot soup energizes the spoon's atoms and free electrons, and they pass that energy along the handle through collisions, so the handle gradually warms even though it isn't touching the soup.
